column8: Bats are not blind.
Goldfish do not have three-second memories.
Humans do not have exactly five senses.
Glass is not a slow-flowing liquid.
The Great Wall is not visible from the Moon.
Bulls are not enraged by the color red.
Chameleons do not change color to match any background.
A penny dropped from a skyscraper cannot kill a pedestrian.
Coffee has more caffeine than tea.
The Pacific Ocean is larger than the Atlantic.
Ants lift more relative to body weight than elephants.
Venus is hotter than Mercury.
A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Sharks existed before trees.
Ice floats because water expands when it freezes.
Plants grow toward light because of auxin.
Vaccines protect because they train the immune system.
Metal feels colder because it conducts heat away faster.
The sky is blue because air scatters blue light.
Exercise strengthens the heart because it is a muscle.
The streets are wet.
The alarm rang.
The plant died.
She is eligible to vote.
The jar holds between twenty and thirty marbles.
The hike takes at least five hours.
Fewer than ten people attended.
The package weighs at most two kilograms.
All mammals breathe air.
No fish can live out of water indefinitely.
Some birds cannot fly.
All squares have four equal sides.
